question: Kye Gompa, the largest centre of Buddhist learning in the Western Himalayas, is situated in the state/union territory of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kye Gompa**

 
 
• Key Gompa is a **Tibetan Buddhist monastery** located on a picturesque hilltop at an altitude of **4,166** m above sea level, close to the** Spiti River**, in the Spiti Valley of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• The monastery has the distinction of being the oldest and the biggest in the Lahaul and Spiti district of Himachal Pradesh and **a religious training centre for lamas**.
 
• Key Monastery is home to around **300 lamas **who receive their religious education here.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some interesting facts that you must know about Himachal Pradesh:

 
 
• Himachal was named by Acharya Diwakar Datt Sharma who was one of the greatest Sanskrit scholar Hima means 'snow' in Sanskrit.
 
• The word 'Himachal' literally translates to 'In the lap of Himalayas'
 
• Himachal Pradesh dates back to the period of Indus Valley Civilization, which flourished 4,000 years ago.
 
• The first Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh was Yashwant Singh Parmar.
 
• Himachal Pradesh has achieved 100 per cent hygiene, and according to reports, every single house has a toilet.
 
• Himachal Pradesh is the second least corrupt state of India after Kerala.
 
• Himachal Pradesh hosted the first Paragliding World Cup in India, in October 2015.
 
• Shimla consists of the only natural ice skating rink in Asia.
